jobs.description:
Position Overview | The Big Picture

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for moving, storing, covering, and preparing props and furniture for warehouse storage or into bins for delivery. The Warehouse Assistant reports to the Warehouse Manager and may take direction from the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Warehouse Lead.


Our Mission Values | Our Commitments

Each employee works together to strive to create the best design company by improving communication, showing genuine care for each other and the company, focusing on delivering quality, and demonstrating professionalism through personal excellence, with a shared passion, dedication, and commitment to providing exceptional value to our clients.

Traits for Success | #hardworker
  • Safety-minded
  • Team player.
  • Great Listener.
  • Steady worker.
  • Good with hands.


Essential Duties | What You’ll Do – The Fun Stuff

  • Learns inventory and pull sheets to successfully fill event orders.
  • Prepares props and furniture for events to include but not limited to: wrapping fabric and vinyl, drilling holes, nailing, hammering, hand and spray painting, polishing, cleaning and staining.
  • Wraps furniture and props for delivery; unwraps inventory as needed.
  • Cleans and sweeps work space to ensure workspace is organized, safe and free from obstacles and debris.
  • Warehouse Assistant levels 2 and 3 perform increasingly more complex and detailed prop and warehouse work and require less supervision.

Other Duties and Safety Requirements | There’s More!
  • Complies with all department and company safety guidelines, procedures, and rules.
  • Mentors safe work practices to co-workers and team.
  • Completes all safety training as directed and within established timelines.
  • Interfaces professionally with all people, internal and external, in a kind and respectful manner.
  • Tracks and enters time and assigns hours and tasks to appropriate events and jobs in time and attendance system.
  • Completes all Human Resources and Payroll tasks and notifications through the Employee Self Service Online Portal on a weekly basis, as directed and within established timelines.
  • Assists in other departments as needed and directed.
  • May perform other duties as required.

Qualifications | What You Need to Bring
  • Ability to understand, read and speak simple English.
  • Good verbal communication skills to communicate successfully with the Warehouse team.
  • Ability to interpret pull sheets.
  • Familiarity with proper packing methods is helpful.
  • Must be able to provide the following tools for use during the work shift: wire cutter and utility knife.
  • Good knowledge and ability to use tools and equipment that may include: hammer, screwdriver, hand drill, tape measure, dollies, and 8 foot and 12 foot ladders.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules to include evenings and weekends.

Physical and Work Environment Requirements | What it is Like in the Shop
  • Ability to stand, kneel, crouch, bend and reach during entire work shift.
  • Able to walk 30% of the work shift.
  • Ability to work with hands and arms during entire shift.
  • Must be able to move and climb ladders without accommodation.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push and pull 30-40 lbs. throughout the shift. Occasionally may move up to and over 100 lbs. with assistance.
  • Ability to handle fragile items safely.
  • Must have 20/20 vision with correction.
  • Must be able to tolerate cold, heat and humid conditions.
  • May be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and chemicals throughout the work shift.
  • Ability to tolerate moderate noise.


Pay & Benefits | What You’ll Receive

  • Hourly wage: $18.00 to $22.00 based on experience.
  • Overtime pay will be provided for hours worked beyond 40 in a workweek at 1.5x the regular rate of pay, in compliance with Illinois labor laws.
  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options available full-time.
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with company matching.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): In compliance with Illinois State Law.
  • Training & Development: Opportunities for skill development and career advancement.

Other Benefits

  • Flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend availability.
  • Safe and supportive work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:
Kehoe Designs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

What Warehouse Operations Contributes To Cardinal Health

Operations is responsible for materials handling and product distribution in a distribution or manufacturing environment. Includes warehousing and fulfillment of materials and products, transportation, inventory management as well as demand, supply and manufacturing planning.

Warehouse Operations is responsible for performing/controlling a combination of manual or automated tasks necessary for the receipt, storage, and shipment of product. This may include functions of receiving, picking, packing, shipping, staging, transporting, storage, delivery, etc. Also responsible for the efficient flow of products from the point of product receipt from vendors to the shipment of products (via prescribed service parameters) to a variety of internal and external customers.

Job Summary

The Assoc II, Warehouse Ops assists on Inbound or Outbound activities as requested by the Warehouse Supervisor meeting quality, safety, productivity and operational standards. This job receives products in the Inbound section. As far as the outbound section, this job ships products.

Responsibilities

  • Unloads trucks in the Inbound section by using a pallet jack or equivalent devices to put pallets out of the trucks.
  • Uses Manhattan Warehouse Management System to check in products. If working with specialty products, must follow regulations to store refrigerated products.
  • Stores products in warehouse locations using order picker or other devices.
  • Picks products from warehouse locations and loads into outbound trucks.

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of experience, preferred
  • High School diploma, GED or equivalent, or equivalent work experience, preferred
  • Ability to bend, reach, stoop, lift and stand for entire shift
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Comfort working with heights 20-30 ft regularly
  • PIT experience is preferred

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies acquired knowledge and skills to complete standard tasks
  • Readily learns and applies new information and methods to work in assigned area
  • Maintains appropriate licenses, training and certifications
  • Works on routine assignments that require some problem resolution
  • Works within clearly defined standard operating procedures and/or scientific methods
  • Adheres to all quality guidelines
  • Works under moderate degree of supervision
  • Work typically involves regular review of output by work lead or supervisor
  • Refers complex unusual problems to supervisor

Candidates who are back-to-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply.

Description

Ready for more than just a job? Build a career with purpose.

At Lactalis in the USA, we’re committed to providing meaningful opportunities for our people to learn, grow, and thrive—whether you’re just starting your journey with us or looking to take the next step in your career. From day one, we offer the tools and support to help you succeed.

As the world leader in dairy, Lactalis is a family-owned company with over 85,000 pragmatic and ambitious professionals across the globe. Each day, we’re proud to produce award-winning dairy products that bring people together.

In the US, we proudly offer an unrivaled house of beloved brands, including Galbani® Italian cheeses and ricotta, Président® specialty cheeses and butters, Kraft® natural and grated cheeses, Breakstone’s® cottage cheese, Cracker Barrel®, Black Diamond® cheddar, and Parmalat® milk. Our yogurt portfolio includes siggi’s®, Stonyfield Organic®, Brown Cow™, Oui®, Yoplait®, Go-Gurt®, :ratio®, Green Mountain Creamery®, and Mountain High®, along with a growing family of ethnic favorites like Karoun®, Gopi®, and Arz®.

At Lactalis, we live by our core values—Ambition, Engagement, and Simplicity. We foster a workplace where innovation thrives, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone’s unique background and ideas are valued.

Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We want to hear about your PASSION, your STORY, and how your EXPERTISE can help us shape the future of dairy.

From your PASSION to ours

Lactalis USA, part of the Lactalis family of companies, is currently hiring a Sr. Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems based in Chicago, IL. As a Sr Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems, the role will carry out responsibilities such as supporting technical solution design, configuration support, integrations, enhancements, testing, deployment, and production support for Blue Yonder WM and related SAP-enabled Supply Chain Execution processes. The role includes working on Functional, technical specifications, interfaces, APIs, data mapping, reporting, troubleshooting, and integration with SAP Inventory Management, Materials Management, Sales/Distribution, Transportation, and Manufacturing processes. Additionally, the Technical Analyst will collaborate with functional analysts, business stakeholders, IT integration teams, and external partners to deliver stable, scalable solutions aligned with company goals and values.

Requirements

From your EXPERTISE to ours

Opportunity in Chicago

Fast Facts

  • Part-Time Opportunity in Chicago: Receiving Associate
  • Based in: Chicago, IL
  • Company: FedEx Supply Chain
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our FedEx Supply Chain team in Chicago, IL is growing.

What You Get

  • Pay Rate: $17-$22/Hour (approx. $20.5k/Year)
  • Benefits: Weekly pay options may be available.
  • Perfect for students or those seeking supplemental income.

Day-to-Day

  • This role focuses on your professional skills with a schedule that fits your life.

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

Local Job Overview: Chicago

Job Title: Overnight Warehouse Associate (Gig/Contract) Hiring Organization: Amazon Based in: Chicago, IL (our growing Chicago office)

Compensation: $21-$25/Hour (approx. $48.4k/Year) Benefits: This role offers competitive pay. Set your own schedule.

Day-to-Day

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Logistics.

  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. Everything accomplished overnight determines the success of the delivery fleet the following morning. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company. Most importantly, you are financially rewarded for your hours with substantial "shift differentials" added directly to your base hourly wage.

Core Nightly Objectives

  1. High-Octane Order Processing: Your primary directive is to clear the digital backlog of orders placed during the evening. You will heavily engage in rapid picking and packing operations to ensure all parcels hit the loading dock before the critical dawn dispatch deadlines.
  2. Sortation and Palletizing: You will sort the completed, labeled packages by their final zip codes, meticulously stacking them onto pallets and wrapping them securely for the local delivery stations that dispatch at sunrise.
  3. Facility Reset and Staging: In the final hours of your shift, you will help reset the massive facility. This includes clearing cardboard debris, sweeping aisles, and fully restocking the packing stations with tape, boxes, and dunnage so the incoming day shift can hit the ground running.

Night Shift Rewards and Benefits

The financial perks of the night shift are undeniable, but they come paired with Amazon's legendary corporate benefits. You do not sacrifice quality of life for working nights. You receive the exact same Day 1 healthcare, dental, and vision insurance as daytime employees. You gain immediate access to our 401(k) matching program and the incredible Career Choice tuition coverage. If you are 18+, can lift up to 49 pounds, and thrive in the moonlight, apply today.

About UPS & Our Culture

You already have a job. You want a second one that actually pays well, does not interfere with your primary career, and comes with benefits that most full-time employers would envy. That is precisely what UPS's Part-Time Evening Warehouse position is built for. Across the country, tens of thousands of UPS associates treat their evening sort shift as a second job that generates an additional $800 to $1,200 per month in take-home income — income that pays off debt, funds vacations, builds emergency savings, and accelerates financial goals that a single income never could. If you are searching for second job warehouse jobs near me, the UPS evening sort is the answer most people wish they had found sooner.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I am a high school teacher by day and a UPS sort associate by evening. The shift runs from 5 PM to 9 PM and I am home before my kids go to bed. The union wages plus the Teamsters medical plan — which I use instead of my district's expensive plan — save my family over $400 a month in insurance costs alone. As a second job warehouse job, UPS is not even comparable to anything else I have seen in this area." - Current Evening Warehouse Associate, Denver, CO.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Second Job Warehouse Associate, you work a focused 3.5 to 5 hour evening sort shift — typically 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM — inside our package center, processing the day's commercial pickup volume in a structured environment that begins after most workdays end and finishes before most evenings are over.

  • Evening Sort Execution: Sort the high-density commercial package volume from the day's business pickups, reading destination routing labels and directing every parcel accurately to the correct outbound belt or trailer lane throughout the peak evening window.
  • Pallet Building & Staging: Stack sorted packages onto outbound pallets, apply shrink wrap, and stage completed loads in designated dock positions ready for linehaul loading — a structured end-of-shift task that creates a satisfying visible output for every associate.
  • Zero Conflict Scheduling: UPS's evening sort schedule is specifically designed to begin after standard business hours and end before most evening personal obligations, making it the most primary-career-compatible second job warehouse shift in the logistics market.

Benefits & Perks

As a second-job UPS associate you still receive the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision coverage that can replace or supplement your primary employer's health plan, plus pension contributions and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance. Weekly paychecks, paid personal days, and contractual wage progression raises are all included on a part-time schedule that never touches your primary working hours.

jobs.description:
Role Based in West Chicago

Role Essentials

  • Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate (Flexible Hours in West Chicago)
  • Location: West Chicago, IL
  • Hiring: UPS
  • This West Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in West Chicago, IL is growing.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Earnings: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $26.7k/Year)
  • Benefits: Employee discounts and perks (where applicable).
  • Excellent work-life balance in West Chicago.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible West Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

jobs.description:
## Join Us in Leading the Future of Snacking

Are you ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? We’re the team behind iconic brands like Oreo, Ritz, and Chips Ahoy!, and we’re looking for a motivated Warehouse Team Member to join our Indianapolis plant on the night shift.

### What You’ll Do

You’ll play a hands-on role in our warehouse operations, ensuring materials move safely and efficiently from receiving to production to shipping. Your days will be varied and fast-paced. You'll operate stand-up counterbalance forklifts, reach trucks, and powered pallet jacks, and use SAP-EWM or RF systems to manage everything from put-away to replenishment. Supporting the Vongal palletizer and inline wrapper operations will also be part of your routine — you’ll keep material flowing and address minor jams, escalating bigger issues to maintenance.

You’ll also:
- Replenish raw and packaging materials into production areas and dough room kits
- Handle trailer loading and unloading, following strict dock safety controls (wheel chocks, gladhand locks, dock lights)
- Use the pallet inverter to transfer materials between wood, plastic, or CHEP pallets
- Complete all SAP transactions accurately for goods movements, confirming lot codes and quantities

### What Safety & Quality Look Like Here

Safety isn’t just a poster on the wall — it’s how we work. You’ll wear required PPE (safety shoes, hearing protection, high-visibility vest), perform daily pre-use inspections on powered equipment, and tag out any machine that needs service. Every near miss or unsafe condition is reported immediately. Food safety is also critical: you’ll inspect materials for damage or contamination, maintain allergen control, and ensure proper segregation of Good/Hold/Reject items.

### Systems & Inventory Accuracy

You’ll keep our inventory visible and accurate in real time by executing warehouse transactions in SAP-EWM/ECC. Cycle counts, wall-to-wall inventories, and reconciling physical vs. system counts will be part of your routine. If you spot a discrepancy, you’ll escalate it promptly to inventory control or supervision.

### Continuous Improvement & Teamwork

We believe in always getting better. You’ll take part in IL6S, Kaizen, and 5S initiatives that improve safety, quality, and efficiency. You’ll keep your workspace clean, organized, and audit-ready, and you’ll communicate regularly with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Logistics teams. If you have experience to share, you’ll help train new team members by modeling safe, standardized work practices.

### What You’ll Need

**Required:**
- High school diploma or GED
- At least 3 years experience in a warehouse, distribution, or manufacturing environment
- 2+ years operating Powered Industrial Vehicles (PIV), including stand-up counterbalance and stand-up reach forklifts
- Familiarity with SAP-EWM or other WMS, plus RFID use
- Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and work in a food-grade environment
- Strong adaptability to take on diverse responsibilities

**Preferred:**
- Experience with automated palletizing or packaging equipment (Vongal, inline wrappers)
- Prior work in food manufacturing, 3PL, or consumer goods
- Knowledge of IL6S, Lean, or 5S principles

### Work Environment & Schedule

This is a warehouse and production floor setting with variable temperatures, exposed to forklifts, conveyors, palletizers, and moderate noise levels. The night shift runs 6:00pm to 6:00am on a 2-2-3 schedule — you’ll work two days, have two off, then work three, repeating the pattern.

### Compensation & Benefits

The hourly wage for this position is **$23.09/hr**. You’ll also be eligible for an annual incentive program targeting 5% of your salary. Mondelez International offers a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, wellness programs, family support resources, life and disability insurance, a 401K retirement savings plan, paid leave, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time — many of which are subsidized or fully paid by the company.

Mondelez Global LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Role Based in East Chicago

Key Information

Salary and Benefits

  • Pay: $20-$23/Hour (approx. $26.3k/Year)
  • Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included.
  • Stable workload with modern tooling and processes.

What You'll Do

  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Logistics space in East Chicago.

Mastering the Overnight Middle Mile

If the fulfillment center is the brain of the operation, the sortation center is the central nervous system. Welcome to the critical "middle mile" of the Amazon delivery network. As a Night Shift Sortation Warehouse Associate, your primary objective is to group and route thousands of packages during the graveyard hours so they reach the correct local delivery hubs right at dawn. For those seeking highly active, fast-paced night shift warehouse jobs that offer intense teamwork and rapid physical movement, this is the ultimate environment.

The Overnight Sortation Experience

Work in a sort center is fundamentally different from a traditional fulfillment role. You are not picking individual items; you are dealing with sealed, completed packages that are moving rapidly down vast networks of conveyor belts. The atmosphere at night is charged, highly focused, and incredibly team-oriented. When the conveyor belts get heavily loaded during the midnight "rush," you will rely on your night-owl teammates to clear the lines and keep the supply chain moving seamlessly.

  1. Rapid Package Routing: You will read complex digital routing labels as packages fly down the line, pulling them off the belt and sorting them into specific geographical chutes or designated postal carts.
  2. Pallet Architecture: You will become a master of spatial reasoning. Sorting requires building perfectly stable, tightly packed pallets of boxes (often referred to as "playing Tetris" by our veteran associates), which are then heavily shrink-wrapped to prevent transit damage.
  3. Fluid Loading Operations: Utilizing manual pallet jacks, you will safely transport these massive, wrapped pallets directly into the bellies of outbound 18-wheeler semi-trailers, staging them for the early morning over-the-road drivers.

"The night sort center moves incredibly fast, but the overnight shift premium is what keeps me here. Working the graveyard shift allows me to manage my college classes during the day while still getting access to Amazon's incredible 401(k) matching and tuition assistance. The night crew is like a family." - A current Night Sortation Associate.

Flexibility and Night Shift Rewards

We understand that modern life requires flexible schedules. Sortation roles offer some of the most adaptable late-night shifts in the logistics careers landscape, including midnight to morning or late evening options. Associates unlock exceptional health, dental, and vision benefits, along with highly competitive shift differentials that significantly boost your base pay when working non-traditional hours. You will need a strong commitment to workplace safety, the ability to lift up to 49 pounds, and a High School diploma or equivalent to join the night team.

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

jobs.title: Warehouse 2nd Shift Shipping Supervisor
jobs.description:
At Concordance Healthcare Solutions, we believe that each team member makes a difference in driving our purpose of positively impacting lives forward. Concordance is committed to our guiding principles of financial stewardship, accountability, forward thinking, aligned relationships and an inclusive culture. This is done through maintaining an unwavering amount of respect and commitment with our employees and customers, being authentic to who we are and operating with the highest levels of integrity. Through our dedicated staff of over 750 employees, working in strategically-located distribution centers across the country, we offer dynamic supply chain solutions to the entire healthcare continuum.
We have a job opening for a full-time 2nd Shift Shipping Supervisor in our Chicago, IL distribution center. The primary role of the Shipping Supervisor is providing leadership and direction for the Shipping department in this location; overseeing handling of merchandise for shipment and departmental staff as efficiently, safely and productively as possible, to ensure that customer expectations are exceeded. Shift time includes 1:00pm to 10:00pm; overtime required.
Essential Functions:
  • The Shipping Supervisor will be responsible for overall management of the Shipping Department in the Chicago location.
  • Responsibilities include organizing the daily workload of department and directs employees accordingly. Works to ensure freight and packages are being moved to destinations on time.
  • Play a key role in interviewing and hiring quality staff members; overseeing a strong training regimen for new staff; continuously developing new and experienced workers; managing staff; and completing performance management reviews on assigned employees twice a year.
  • Oversees and is directly involved (hands on) in the following Shipping operations: productivity, quality, freight handling, including, but not limited to, customer service, and safety. This role is responsible for ensuring prompt, efficient and accurate handling of merchandise as well as developing and implementing team goals.
  • In addition to supervising Shipping staff, this position is also responsible for providing leadership by example while assisting with daily shipping functions. This includes performing duties, such as building and consolidating pallets of customer shipment; organization and staging of the department; preparing orders for shipment with external carriers, such as UPS and FedEx and other various duties.
  • Ensures that departments keep a clean and orderly work environment. Assigns general custodial tasks and establishes cleaning schedule for areas. Supports a healthy and safe work environment by communicating unsafe conditions immediately.
  • Maintains warehouse equipment to ensure safety of employees; addresses any mechanical issues that are reported.
  • Works proactively to foster and maintain a positive team-oriented atmosphere at all times.
  • Other duties as assigned.
What You will Need to be Successful:
  • High school diploma, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of three years of related experience required and one year in warehouse operations or distribution is preferred.
  • Previous experience supervising, training, developing and providing direction to staff a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of Voice Pick and VAI systems (or similar warehouse management or operating system) is preferred.
  • Must be able to lift/pull/carry at least 70 pounds; must be willing/able to stand and walk for entire shift, often over 8 hours. With or without accommodation.
  • Strong customer service, problem solving, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to effectively build relationships are essential.
  • Self-starter with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively as a member of a team.
  • Successfully pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check and drug screening.
Work Location:
  • This role is located in Chicago, IL.

Compensation: $65,000-$70,000 annually.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Identifies, transports, packs, removes and disposes of products and materials.

Your Next Step in Lombard

Role in Lombard: Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate Hiring Organization: UPS Location: Lombard, IL

Compensation: $21-$23/Hour (approx. $26.6k/Year) Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included. Stable workload with modern tooling and processes.

What You'll Do

Apply your your professional skills skills at our Lombard location.

  • This Lombard-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Lombard, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Lombard, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

The twilight shift is one of the highest-volume sort windows in the entire UPS network, processing the enormous wave of packages picked up from businesses throughout the workday. If you are searching for UPS warehouse jobs that align perfectly with a daytime school schedule or a morning-shift primary job, our twilight sort operation — typically running 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM — is the ideal entry into one of America's most respected logistics careers. These warehouse jobs come with full union representation and real long-term potential.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The twilight shift fits my life perfectly. I go to class in the morning, work at UPS in the evening, and my tuition is being covered by Earn & Learn. The shift itself is fast and the team is incredibly motivated — everyone knows we have a hard window to hit and we go after it together. These are the best UPS warehouse jobs for students, hands down." - Current Twilight Warehouse Associate, Chicago, IL.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Twilight Shift Warehouse Associate, you process the peak commercial pickup volume of the day during the evening sort window. You will rotate through loading, sorting, and unloading functions as directed by your sort manager within our package center.

  • Commercial Pickup Processing: Sort the high-density commercial package volume collected from business pickups during the day, routing each parcel accurately onto outbound belts and trailers for overnight transport.
  • Multi-Function Rotation: Work fluidly across unloading, sorting, and loading assignments as the twilight sort manager redistributes labor to balance throughput across the facility's busiest evening hours.
  • Sort Accuracy Compliance: Maintain UPS's required sort accuracy rate by carefully verifying destination labels and barcode scans before releasing any package onto an outbound conveyor.

Benefits & Perks

Twilight Warehouse Associates receive Teamsters union wages with annual progression raises, medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and the UPS Earn & Learn tuition program. The evening shift window makes this one of the most student-friendly warehouse jobs in the market.

Job Summary:

Target takes pride in its top-ranking position among retailers in the US. Its aim is to make daily life for families as enjoyable and stress-free as possible with its superior product and service offerings.

Roles and Duties:

  • Respect and observe all safety regulations and policies to foster a safe and secure working environment for everyone.
  • Acquire the necessary skills needed to work in a high-volume warehouse by attending safety training sessions.
  • Perform various activities such as packing, loading, and shipping goods to support the distribution of items to stores and customers.
  • Maintain the accuracy of product processing to ensure successful delivery to our stores and customers.
  • Keep safety, swiftness, and efficiency at the forefront of handling freight and moving inventory during warehouse activities.
  • A clean and tidy work area is an essential component of maintaining a professional and competent work image.
  • Being punctual at work and carrying out assigned tasks with precision and timeliness are essential for job performance.
  • To sustain continuous improvement, it's essential to monitor and measure progress over time. This can involve tracking key metrics related to process improvements and identifying areas for ongoing refinement
  • Sustains a genial and cooperative attitude when working on tasks alone or with fellow team members.

Requirements:

  • Possesses the strength and endurance to frequently lift and transport items ranging from 35-50 pounds during a work shift.
  • Can move and transport items weighing up to 60 pounds occasionally during their work shift.
  • Carry out work duties that demand regular standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching actions.
  • A positive and respectful approach is crucial to succeeding in both solo projects and team efforts.
  • Possessing a sound understanding of rudimentary mathematical skills, including counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Proficient in reading and understanding product information on labels, tickets, and documentation.
  • After undergoing training, one can competently use computer systems and handheld devices without much supervision.
  • A significant component of having strong communication skills is the ability to articulate effectively and accurately
  • The ability to comprehend and follow safety procedures, practices, and instructions necessitates adequate proficiency in reading, speaking, and comprehending the English language.

Additional Requirements:

  • Knowledgeable about the safe use of all powered equipment, such as Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit Down & Standup Forklift, and can work at heights of up to 40ft as required.
  • Engage in work activities that entail being stationed on a mezzanine level, reaching a height of up to 40 ft, wherever relevant
  • Capable of performing duties in temperature-controlled settings, including refrigeration and freezing units, throughout the workday.

Benefits:

Eligible Target team members have the option to enroll in a comprehensive benefits package, but must also adhere to the applicable eligibility requirements and other stipulations.

Note:

Your chances of getting the Warehouse Operations position will depend on your fitness for either the Warehousing Worker or Warehouse Associate positions, based on your performance in the questionnaire and assessment during the application process. Below are the prerequisites for both roles, with access to extensive information on job duties provided by accessing the links at the end of this page.

Description

Have the drive to succeed? Join the Staff Management | SMX team as a Warehouse Production Associate at our premier client, Flex-N-Gate, the leading manufacturer and supplier of front-end components for the automotive industry, in the Chicago, IL area!

This warehouse position is located in the Hegewisch neighborhood in Chicago, IL.

Available Shift:
  • C Crew Shift - 4 days total: Friday & Saturday, 6:00 AM - 6:00 PM; and then Sunday & Monday, 6:00 PM - 6:00 AM

Associates in this position have the chance to join the client's team on a permanent basis. The ideal candidate will have prior manufacturing experience and can successfully pass a pre-employment physical ability assessment.

Please note that this is a temp-to-hire position, so it will not be an immediate start.

Start your engines with Staff Management | SMX and apply today!

jobs.title: Warehouse Generalist- 3rd shift
jobs.description:
Schedule:

Sunday-Thursday 10pm-6:30am

Pay: $20.50/hr

Use a variety of material handling equipment to move products, equipment, and materials on and off trucks or throughout the facility while following all regulatory and company safety standards, policies, and procedures.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Put away palletized units by lifting forks for placement into racks above floor height
  • Pick palletized units out of rack locations above floor height and set up for outbound shipment
  • May choose and record materials, weight, counts, and condition of food items via Radio Frequency (RF) system
  • Load and unload materials on and off pallets, skids, or lifting device
  • Read and follow computerized work orders to determine quantities, types of products to be shipped and the location of requested items in the warehouse
  • Document and report damages and discrepancies to supervisors or leads
  • May need to pack, seal, and label materials/pallets for shipping using Radio Frequency (RF) scanning equipment to document and verify counts of picked items; otherwise, ensure all palletized stock is securely wrapped before placement on racks or transporting through the warehouse
  • Complete daily forklift maintenance/check sheet
  • Monitor battery charge and leave material handling equipment at the designated storage area; may need to maintain and clean batteries, depending on site
  • Alert appropriate leader of any issues with the product or materials and await directions to rectify the problem
  • Help clean and organize the warehouse at the end or throughout the shift

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES)

  • Must be able to identify products through reading, interpreting, and scanning or manually inputting pallet identification numbers
  • Basic math skills
  • Ability to understand instructions in Country's official language or as defined by Lineage Logistics
  • Ability to work in temperatures as low as -20 Fahrenheit/-25 Celsius in cold storage sites or up to 100 Fahrenheit/37 Celsius in dry storage sites while wearing company provided personal protective equipment and freezer gear
  • Must be able to lift a minimum of 40 lbs./18 kgs.; weight may be more dependent upon facility
  • Ability to work a flexible work schedule and shift, including weekends if needed
  • Must be comfortable with various noise levels, at times, can be loud

Pay Range:$16.97 - $28.65

Why Lineage?

This is an excellent position to begin your career path within Lineage! Success in this role enables greater responsibilities and promotions! A career at Lineage starts with learning about our business and how each team member plays a part each and every day to satisfy our customers’ requirements. Beyond that, you’ll help us grow and learn on our journey to be the very best employer in our industry. We’ll ask you for your opinion and ensure we do our part to keep you developing and engaged as we grow our business. Working at Lineage is energizing and enjoyable. We value respect and care about our team members.

Lineage is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful harassment and retaliation. Lineage will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability or any other protected status under federal, state and local law.

Benefits


Lineage provides safe, stable, reliable work environments, medical, dental, and basic life and disability insurance benefits, 401k retirement plan, paid time off, annual bonus eligibility, and a minimum of 7 holidays throughout the calendar year.

jobs.title: Warehouse Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The 2023 US Best Managed Company Award recognizes companies that outperform their competition in the four critical areas of management: strategic planning, effective execution, culture, and governance/financial performance. As a recipient of this accolade, Coke Florida has distinguished itself as a leader among U.S. private organizations.

What We Offer:

If you are a full-time employee at Coke Florida, you are eligible to enroll in our Total Rewards Program and take advantage of its many offerings:

  • The all-inclusive plans for wellness consist of medical, dental, and vision coverage that aims to provide complete health support to the employees
  • The employer-sponsored 401K plan includes a healthy company match, ensuring employees receive even higher returns on their contributions
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • The company provides its employees with 11 paid holidays and a vacation pay for three weeks annually
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • EAPs may offer a variety of services, including counseling, legal and financial advice, substance abuse treatment, and referrals to community resources
  • Competitive compensation

The Winter Haven Coke Florida site necessitates a Warehouse Lead, and we are hiring for the first shift.

What you will do:

The primary responsibility of a Coke Florida Warehouse Supervisor is to oversee the storage and shipping of materials.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Assumes responsibility for a group of 25-30 warehouse workers
  • Developing a team requires coaching, guiding, collaborating, and enhancing the abilities of those who work together
  • Administer the regular functions of the storage establishment
  • Arrange Warehouse Team Members to Meet Demands of Facility
  • Dedicate a section of your storage area for the proper rotation of goods
  • Assist with the regulation of inventory levels and mitigate the likelihood of product loss
  • Oversee the handling and storage of goods during transportation and upon arrival
  • Secure company assets
  • Adopting cost-cutting measures can help organizations manage labor and OPEX budgets effectively

Attention to detail is essential, as you will be dealing with important information and sensitive client data:

  • The minimum educational requirement for this position is either a high school diploma or its equivalent, the GED
  • This role requires a minimum of two years' relevant experience in the warehouse or distribution field
  • Experience in managing both human and financial resources is a must-have for this position
  • Employers require candidates to possess leadership skills and have at least two years' experience in a warehouse or distribution supervisor role
  • The skill to manage a manual or powered pallet jack proficiently is a fundamental necessity for all individuals responsible for transporting goods
  • You must have forklift certification before starting your job

Having a broad range of skills, knowledge, and experience can make you an invaluable addition to the team. Expanding your expertise in different areas, such as marketing, data analysis, or project management, can show that you are adaptable, flexible, and capable of handling various tasks and projects:

  • Advanced Excel experience
  • Familiarity with the efficient management of inventory systems and aptitude with SAP software preferred

The role requires a significant amount of physical effort, which means:

  • The talent to repeatedly raise, carry, and position bulky objects weighing up to 50 pounds without any help is mandatory
  • The position demands that the individual has the strength to push and pull items weighing no more than 50 pounds. The tasks should be executed while bending at the knees, kneeling, squatting, and reaching at different levels
  • The competency to use manual transport equipment (e.g. pallet jack or hand truck) to move product loads repeatedly for a distance of at least 100 yards without any assistance
  • The skill to repeatedly take hold of and operate objects that come in various sizes and weights that require deft finger movements and coordination between the hands and eyes
  • The capacity to sustain physical efforts for prolonged periods of time is a vital requirement for individuals who are involved in jobs that necessitate continuous manual labor
  • Flexibility in Reading Small, Medium, and Large Print
  • Demonstrating the ability to stand for a minimum of 8 hours while at work, and potentially extending up to 10 hours
  • The requirement to walk a minimum of 4 hours during the workday
  • Frequently perform tasks within an environment that is hot and humid indoors
  • The aptitude to equip an auditory aid to comprehend directions delivered in the English tongue

Other details:

  • Job Family: Warehouse
  • Job Function: Warehouse
  • Pay Type: Salary

Coke Florida may update this job description at any time and assign further duties and responsibilities as necessary.

The employee's ability to perform the essential job functions to satisfaction is a prerequisite to employment at Coke Florida. The company may offer reasonable accommodations to disabled employees to enable them to perform their job duties, provided it does not cause undue burden.

All applicants and employees are treated with respect, dignity, and consideration irrespective of their background or identity.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate - 2nd Shift - Days Off: Tuesdays & Wednesdays
jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate - 2nd Shift

Warehouse associates will ensure the needs of both production and warehouse are met throughout their respective shifts by the timely and safe delivery, shipping, and receiving of produce and packaged goods.

Detailed Responsibilities

Receiving

  • Will apply glad hand lock and wheel chocks for any trailer to unload
  • Will assist FSQA and receivers with breakdown of pallets for quality checks and to transport to storage
  • When produce or packaged good are received in the associate will place produce/packaged goods into correct storage
  • Placed produce/packaging must be staged according to FIFO and in correct temperature storage location and remove any plastic from produce that needs to breathe
  • Notify leadership if any product is found to be out of correct location
  • Work on creating space for inbound loads
  • Ensure all storage pods are kept free of debris

Replenishing

  • Set floor for decanting and shipping lines per drop list and boxing call out
  • All packaging material is set for box team, shipping lines, and decanting area
  • Prior to production running completely out of product, the warehouse associate will bring out the requested material according to the production's count.
  • Answer call of any additional product needs for production
  • Move anything needed for production, warehouse, sanitation, or FSQA
  • Prior to leaving for any break, warehouse associates will check with the production team as well as make a visual check of produce/packaging in use to ensure the area is fully stocked before leaving production area.
  • Near the end of each shift remove any material from the drop zone as well as the return area that production will not use for the incoming shift. All product is returned to home location
  • Ensure all pallets in storage are front faced, leveled, and plastic removed
  • Warehouse associate is responsible for organization of assigned storage areas

Shipping

  • Check all trailers loaded on the shipping dock for trash or pine pallets, remove any items found that are not needed for completed shipments
  • Put on glad hand lock on trailer and chock wheels prior to being loaded
  • Using the load diagram form load trucks with completed pallets with management approval - full load 26 pallets
  • Once the trailer has been fully loaded, place a FedEx seal on the closed trailer door to signify ready for ship and put the serial number for the load seal on the load diagram form and we remove the glad hand lock. Turn in paperwork to leadership

Support other Warehouse functions

  • We are one team. Team members are expected to assist with completing any function needed for our company to deliver finished goods to the customer. This includes using any equipment certified on or assisting other departments to get the job done for the day.

General Responsibilities

  • Follow all safety procedures throughout execution of all tasks. This includes, but is not limited to, performing pre-shift equipment checks for all equipment used and wearing required PPE. Safety first!
  • Follow the facility GMPs and help enforce them throughout the facility.
  • Sign for all equipment needed to perform your duties. Ensure these are signed back in upon completion of shift.
  • Support the efforts of the company to maintain our food safety system (SQF) and quality programs. Quality always!
  • Be respectful of others. Team members are expected to carry themselves in a professional manner in all situations and at all times.

Qualifications

  • General high school degree, or equivalent, (e.g. GED). GED or High School diploma required
  • Willing to learn how to operate equipment needed to perform all warehouse duties including, but not limited to, manual and electric pallet jack and hand held scanners.
  • Able to lift up to 50lbs
  • Previous warehouse experience preferred

jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a bilingual dedicated and energetic Janitorial Specialist to maintain cleanliness and safety within a busy warehouse environment. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the facility remains spotless, sanitized, and well-maintained, supporting a safe and efficient workspace for all team members. Your proactive approach to cleaning, equipment handling, and safety adherence will help uphold our high standards of sanitation and facility upkeep. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals with janitorial or custodial experience who thrive in fast-paced settings and take pride in their work.

Duties

  • Perform comprehensive cleaning tasks across the warehouse, including sweeping, mopping, dusting, and trash removal to maintain a tidy environment.
  • Operate various cleaning equipment such as floor buffers, scrubbers, and vacuums to ensure optimal floor care and sanitation.
  • Handle chemical agents safely by following proper chemical handling safety procedures, including mixing, storage, and disposal.
  • Conduct heavy lifting and manual handling of cleaning supplies, equipment, and waste materials while adhering to safe lifting practices.
  • Maintain sanitation standards by disinfecting high-touch surfaces and ensuring compliance with safety protocols at all times.
  • Support facilities maintenance activities such as minor repairs or reporting issues that require specialized attention.
  • Assist with industrial cleaning tasks including the use of specialized tools for large-scale cleaning projects in the warehouse setting.
  • Provide excellent customer service by responding promptly to cleaning requests or concerns from team members or supervisors.

Experience

  • Prior janitorial or custodial experience in a commercial or industrial setting is preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate cleaning equipment such as floor buffers and scrubbers effectively.
  • Knowledge of chemical agent handling safety procedures and sanitation standards.
  • Experience with heavy lifting and manual handling in a warehouse or facilities environment.
  • Familiarity with safety protocol adherence related to custodial work, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Background in facilities maintenance or industrial cleaning is advantageous.
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining high cleanliness standards in busy environments.

Join our team as a Janitorial Specialist and play a vital role in creating a safe, clean, and welcoming warehouse environment! Your dedication to quality cleaning practices combined with your safety awareness will ensure our facility remains efficient and compliant while supporting our team’s success.

Position in Chicago, IL

Fast Facts

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.
  • Benefits: This role offers competitive pay.
  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.
  • Employer: UPS (Hiring in Chicago)

  • Salary: $22-$26/Hour (approx. $50.8k/Year)
  • Based in: Chicago, IL (a key business district)
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

When UPS says immediate hire, we mean it. During peak season, our package center teams expand by thousands of associates in a matter of weeks, and we have built our onboarding system to get people working — and getting paid — as fast as any warehouse employer in America. If you are searching for seasonal warehouse jobs hiring immediately with a brand name you trust, competitive hourly pay, and a genuine shot at a permanent career, our Peak Warehouse Sorter position is open and ready for you right now. No lengthy application process, no multi-week waiting period — UPS peak hiring is designed for speed because the packages do not wait for anyone.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I applied on a Monday and was working by Thursday. The onboarding process at UPS during peak is extremely fast and well-organized — they know how to bring large numbers of people in quickly without it feeling chaotic. The pay was better than I expected for a seasonal warehouse job hiring immediately, the overtime was genuinely available, and I was offered a permanent position before the season even ended." - Former Peak Sorter, Now Permanent Associate, Seattle, WA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Seasonal Peak Warehouse Sorter, you join our package center sort operation during the November-through-January holiday window, processing the highest package volumes of the year with speed and accuracy that keeps America's holiday delivery commitments intact.

  • Rapid Onboarding & Immediate Start: Complete UPS's streamlined peak-season onboarding process — safety orientation, method training, and first sort shift — within days of your offer letter, with your first paycheck arriving the following week without exception.
  • Peak Volume Sorting: Sort dramatically elevated holiday package volumes on high-speed conveyor systems, reading destination routing codes and diverting parcels accurately to outbound lanes at full production rate within your first few shifts on the job.
  • Overtime Priority Access: As a seasonal sorter during peak, you have first access to available overtime hours during the highest-volume weeks — Black Friday, Cyber Monday, pre-Christmas — generating a seasonal paycheck significantly larger than standard hours provide.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Seasonal Peak Warehouse Sorters receive competitive hourly pay, weekly direct-deposit paychecks, and significant overtime availability throughout the peak window. Associates who demonstrate performance and reliability during the seasonal period receive formal permanent hire consideration — converting a temporary position into a Teamsters union career complete with medical, dental, vision, pension, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition benefits.

What started as a small antique store in 1977 has become a nationally recognized neighborhood sandwich shop with over 400 locations across the United States. What’s In It For You**:

No two days in our warehouse look the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.


One day you might be gathering and staging materials for a brand-new Potbelly shop getting ready to open. The next, you could be packaging individual items for shipping to existing shops, cleaning and organizing the warehouse, or helping prep millwork and materials for finishing.


If you’re mechanically minded, enjoy working with your hands, and tackling unique projects, you’ll fit right in. Our warehouse team keeps things moving behind the scenes and plays a huge role in helping our shops succeed.


This isn’t a sit-at-a-desk-all-day kind of job. It’s hands-on, fast-paced, physical work where teamwork, organization, and problem-solving matter. If you like variety, staying busy, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll probably love it here.


FOCUS

  • Pulls and distributes materials, artifacts, or other stock items to fill orders.
  • Prepares and packages goods for shipping.
  • Maintains accurate inventory records using inventory software.
  • Receives goods and enters all items into inventory.
  • Operates material handling equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, etc.
  • Loads trucks with goods, makes deliveries, and picks up material from local vendors.
  • Keeps the warehouse clean and organized.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Must be able to lift up to 75 pounds frequently.
  • Must be able to communicate through telephone, e-mail and in-person communications.

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND BEHAVIORS

jobs.title: Warehouse Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry's best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you've found the right job posting.

The Role

As a Warehouse Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for managing the internal supply chain functions of our Facility.

You will play a vital role in ensuring the day-to-day success of the operation across all functions of the day-to-day business at CookUnity. You'll be a team leader, driving efficiency, accuracy, and a positive workplace culture across a team of hardworking warehouse Supervisors and Associates

This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who wants to take ownership inventory accuracy and excellent customer service to internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Manage accuracy and compliance of the ingredient and packaging receiving practices to ensure financial accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Review site layouts to develop optimal storage and handling of ingredients and packaging
  • Focus on the "Distribution Model" deployment across all categories (Protein, Produce, Dairy, Dry Goods and Packaging) and Marketplaces
  • Develop and ensure ongoing compliance with process for checking incoming shipments versus invoices and order sheets.
  • Train and develop team members to ensure that they have the skills and resources required to successfully manage and handle all operational needs.
  • Focus on continuous improvement across core functions including but not limited to: receiving, inventory counting, purchasing, quality assurance, ingredient distribution and food safety compliance (HACCP).
  • Create and establish a food safety MOVEMENT! Implementing and complying with best in class handling, receiving and distribution practices by collaborating with our Food Safety Team.
  • Continuous oversight of inventory to ensure optimal levels of product
  • Aid in development and implementation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to help ensure Marketplace functions are operating at highest efficiency levels
  • Maintain excellent relationships with our chef partners and work hand in hand with other departments across the CookUnity organization.
  • Understanding of Profit and Loss (P&L) statements, variance reports and KPI metrics
  • Oversight of scheduling for the Marketplace team, according to labor budget.
  • Any other marketplace tasks based on business needs.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role, managing receiving, shipping, inventory and/or warehousing functions in a manufacturing or wholesale distribution facility (food industry preferred).
  • Minimum of 3 years of people management experience
  • Strong understanding of HACCP and OSHA guidelines
  • Experience in food procurement and extensive food knowledge
  • Experience in inventory management
  • Expert understanding of supply chain or inventory control software (ERP, MRP, WMS platforms such as SAP, NetSuite, Infor, etc.)
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented
  • Understanding of food safety and quality standards
  • Ability to promote professional growth and development of the entire Marketplace team.
  • Ability to communicate and understand Spanish is preferred.
  • Ability to travel 5-10% as needed to support other locations

Benefits

  • Health Insurance coverage
    • PTO policy and paid sick days
  • We grow, you grow: Stock Options Plan granted on Day 1.
  • Eligible for bi-annual performance bonus
  • Family leave fully paid
  • Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises
  • A generous amount of CookUnity credits to enjoy our amazing meals, added to your account, monthly
  • ‍️ Wellness perks: access to fitness subsidies to build a healthy lifestyle
    • ‍
  • Personalized Spanish coach
  • Awesome opportunity to join a company that is looking to change how we eat and how chefs work!

  • ️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

#ENG1P

If you're interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!


CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We've recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief "proof of humanity" to confirm that we're connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you're unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We'll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don't share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you're unsure about a message, we'd much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

Berlin Packaging is the premier supplier of rigid packaging. With over $3 billion in revenue, we have grown 5x faster than the overall packaging industry since 1898.

Chances are you enjoy products supplied by us every day! We serve virtually every end market: automotive, beverage, food, home care, industrial chemical, pet care and veterinary, personal health and beauty, wine and spirits, and cannabis.

Our engagement scores are 2x the national average, and every employee shares in Berlin's profitable growth. Combined with our "Anything is Possible" mindset and our winning culture, our 2,000+ employees agree, we love it here!

Are you up for the opportunity of a lifetime? If so, we are seeking a Warehouse Associate on day shift, who aids in the preparation of shipments and/or receipt of product.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Prepare ware for shipment
  • Prepare ware for storage in warehouse
  • Maintain an accurate account of inventory
  • Maintain an efficient and orderly warehouse
  • Fulfill the employee portion of the Berlin Values by demonstrating a strong work ethic, teamwork, loyalty, innovation, productivity and driving profitable results.
  • Other tasks as required

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • High school diploma or GED strongly preferred
  • Prior warehouse experience strongly preferred
  • Ability to complete tasks and solve problems with high attention to detail
  • Demonstrates a strong work ethic and ability to learn
  • Has a positive attitude and contributes to a positive team culture
  • Self-motivated; reliable, with strong initiative and results orientation
  • Models safe work practices
  • Is computer literate

Working Environment and Physical Requirements:
Must be able to frequently lift and move boxes weighing up to 20lbs and occasionally lift and move boxes and/or pallets up to 45lbs through warehouse environment.

Berlin Packaging offers an outstanding compensation and benefits package including:

  • Competitive PTO including vacation, personal days, holidays, and sick time
  • 1Berlin Shared Ownership Plan
  • Profit sharing
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs) for transportation, medical, and dependent care expenses
  • Paid parental leave for up to 12weeks
  • Health club reimbursement
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • 529 college savings plan
  • Employee Assistance Program for mental health and well-being
  • Calm app to improve mental wellbeing
  • Employee referral program
  • Company sponsored short- and long-term disability and life insurance with optional voluntary life insurance

At Berlin Packaging, we look at candidates' skills but hire based on traits. We believe in hiring smart, passionate people who are enthusiastic to learn and develop their skills. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Distribution Seed Handler
jobs.description:
Description

Ball Horticultural Company is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused candidate to join our Seed Processing Center as a Distribution Seed Handler. Ball is the world's largest breeder, producer, and distributor of flower seed, providing outstanding products, best-in-class customer service, and reliable supply to professional growers around the globe. In this role, you will support the accurate distribution of seed by packaging, verifying, storing, and maintaining inventory while ensuring quality standards, inventory accuracy, and timely order fulfillment.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Pull/Package/Verify/Seal seed packages
  • Operate packaging machines
  • Operate package sealing machines
  • Count inventory
  • Put away inventory
  • Maintain inventory
  • Retrieve seed from refrigerated vault and seed warehouse
  • Replenish packaging supplies
  • Use SAP and other system tools for inquiries and to manage materials
  • Assist with physical inventory
  • Perform quality checks
  • Lifting / bending / stooping - see seed job description for specifics
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • High School graduate or equivalent (G.E.D.) required.
  • Basic Math skills needed: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division
  • Ability to work overtime on short notice
  • Ability to operate mechanical equipment, as this may be required in some areas
  • Must work well as part of a team


Pay Range: $16-$18/hour


Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift/carry 40+ pounds
  • Ability to sit and stand for prolonged periods of time (8 hours or more);
  • Physical mobility to reach, bend and stoop
  • For some roles, must have the ability to work in cold vault (40 degrees)
  • Have good range of motion with extremities - requires repetitive work


Our promise to you

Ball is a global leader in horticulture: we develop, produce, and sell plants around the world. Our vision is to color the world through our customers. We create excitement in the world of flowers and are the first choice for service. We deliver all the best and nothing else! To you, we deliver a work environment and a culture where building long-lasting relationships internally and externally is important. We believe that good communication, sharing ideas and collaborating on projects will set us up for success.

We keep both our feet on the ground and are approachable.


In addition to this we provide a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, life and long-term disability insurance, paid parental leave
  • 401k/Profit Sharing Retirement Plan
  • Part time off benefits including vacation and holidays
  • Tuition assistance
  • Employee Assistance Program and Positive Health programs
  • An onsite subsidized cafe overlooking renowned display gardens and restored natural areas
